annotations.title: Cut struck-out words from the video

description: Edit by text: cuts the words you strike out of a post's video. Give ranges of word indexes in a take (the i of edit_get with words true). Each cut sits in the quiet beside the words, 40 ms from the words that stay, never inside one; all the ranges are saved as one new rev. Free on every plan. Pass base_rev; EDIT_CONFLICT means get the edit again and strike the words again. Undo with undo. Ranges already cut, or in no clip of the edit, change nothing and no rev is made. skipped lists runs left in because the piece beside them would be under 0.1 s.

base_rev.description: The rev your ranges start from (edit_get's rev)

from.description: First struck word: its i from edit_get with words

take.description: The take's id (edit_get lines have it)

to.description: Last struck word (the same as from for one word)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
